newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Thursday on some late selling in tune with lower Japanese prices, brokers said.
Prices in Tokyo and Kobe eased on long-liquidation, prompted by expectations that coming months would witness an oversupply.
In Singapore the morning session was untraded except for some speculative trade in the ring sessions for the September RSS3 contract by some overseas brokers, traders said.
"But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo and Kobe," a local broker said.
"The market was pretty quiet today with no incentives as the big boys (tyre companies) were not around and there were no Chinese enquiries," said another broker.
He said some exchange-for-physicals led to a softer tone in the afternoon and the volume was moderate.
At around 0945 GMT, January/March RSS3 fell 2.75 cents to 106.50 U.S. cents a kg.
August RSS1 fell 3.50 cents to 146.25 Singapore cents (US$1.02) a kg.
August TSR20 fell 2.25 cents to 138.00 Singapore cents (US$0.97) a kg.
